title: Tunisian Beef Tagine
description: A hearty, slow-cooked stew originating from Tunisia, made with tender beef and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, cinnamon, turmeric, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven. Braise the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Skim off any excess fat from the surface of the tagine.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
